publishable.name: Jan Hussain
publishable.lastSeenLocationPublic: Croftfoot Road area, south-east Glasgow, Scotland, United Kingdom
publishable.shortSummary: Police Scotland are appealing for public help to trace Jan Hussain. He was reported missing from Birmingham and is believed to have travelled to south-east Glasgow on Wednesday, 25 March 2026. Public information places him around the Croftfoot Road area.
publishable.publicDescription: Police Scotland are appealing for public help to trace Jan Hussain. He was reported missing from Birmingham and is believed to have travelled to south-east Glasgow on Wednesday, 25 March 2026. Public information places him around the Croftfoot Road area.
publishable.physicalDescription: around 5ft 7in, with shoulder-length brown hair, and of medium build
publishable.clothing: brown trousers and a grey t-shirt
publishable.travelContext: Believed to have travelled from Birmingham to south-east Glasgow.
publishable.contactInstruction: Contact Police Scotland on 101 quoting reference 2424 of 30 March, 2026.
